en.title: The release date of ``Algolemeth'', an RPG in which you conquer dungeons using golems with programmed behavior, has been set for January 26, 2027. Fully automatic combat and exploration
en.summary: Kakehashi Games and RawFury announced today that the release date of the PC game "Algolemeth" has been set for January 26, 2027. This work is an RPG in which you send golems with programmed behavior to conquer dungeons. The player becomes an alchemist, forms a party of golems, and aims to conquer the Tower of Corruption, a tower of pollution.

Half a month after its launch, "Monster Hunter: Traveler" has remained in the top 5 best-selling iOS games in Japan. On the iOS side, in Europe, America and Japan, the revenue in Japan exceeds 60% (sourced from Diandian data). Some practitioners attribute this to IP influence and purchase volume. However, according to the international version of AppGrowing, the amount of material released for this game in Japan is not high. Chule asked project members. items.title: 長期反復タスクにおけるAIコーディングエージェントの性能低下をベンチマークする「SlopCodeBench」
items.summary: AIにプログラムを作成させると短時間で動作するコードを得られますが、機能の追加を繰り返すうちに古い処理との整合性が崩れたりコードが複雑になったりすることがあります。こうした問題を調べるために開発され、AI自身が作ったコードに新しい仕様を段階的に追加させながら機能の維持や品質の変化を測定するベンチマークが「SlopCodeBench」です。続きを読む...

zh.title: “SlopCodeBench”对 AI 编码代理在长期重复性任务中的性能退化进行基准测试

en.title: "SlopCodeBench" benchmarks the performance degradation of AI coding agents in long-term repetitive tasks
en.summary: When you let AI create a program, you can get code that works in a short time, but as you repeatedly add functions, the consistency with old processes may be broken or the code may become complicated. ``SlopCodeBench'' is a benchmark that was developed to investigate these problems and measures the maintenance of functionality and changes in quality while gradually adding new specifications to the code created by AI itself. read more...
